snippet.title: Psalm 51: How to be Joyful When You Feel Ashamed
snippet.description: Have you ever royally messed up? There’s a decent chance it’s not as bad as David. He commits adultery with the wife of one of his most loyal men, and then kills him. For awhile, David is able to hold it together. But eventually the shame of his sin and mistakes is too much to bear. But even in this, he is able to find the joy of the Lord through his salvation in Psalm 51.
